## Part 6 · Coming soon

Guided projects will take a research question from raw public data to a figure and regression table. Each will include a partially completed starter notebook and a full solution.

The planned questions will reuse the cleaning, plotting and interpretation skills from Parts 1–5, with less guidance each time. Datasets and redistribution rights will be checked before projects are added.

For now, begin with [your first notebook](../lessons/00-start/02-first-notebook.ipynb) or explore the [course map](../lessons/index.qmd).
